children: U.S. industrial tech firm's fiscal Q4 sales rose 10% year-over-year on organic growth
Adjusted diluted EPS for fiscal Q4 increased 17.5% year-over-year
Company completed Honeywell Technologies’ Productivity Solutions acquisition, expects 23% EPS growth in fiscal 2027
Brady expects fiscal 2027 adjusted diluted EPS of $6.25 to $6.75
Company sees about $0.80 adjusted diluted EPS accretion from IPS, mostly in second half
Brady expects IDS segment organic revenue growth of about 5% and IPS revenue of about $1.15 bln
ORGANIC SALES GROWTH - Co said organic sales growth drove 8.4% increase in Q4 sales, especially in Americas & Asia
ACQUISITIONS - Co said acquisitions contributed to sales growth and expanded addressable market
EXPANDING MARGINS - Co said expanding margins contributed to 15% increase in adjusted EPS for fiscal 2026
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the business support supplies peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Brady Corporation is $109.00, about 20.9% above its September 2 closing price of $90.18
The stock recently traded at 14 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 15 three months ago
